$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：天梁獨坐子午，《深造講義》p.141。

basis.quote: 须注意其为孤克，抑为融合

rules.text: 孤剋的一面較重：除了六親關係較淡，人生也較落落寡合；只宜從事專業或學術研究。
rules.en: The solitary side is stronger: besides cooler family ties, life is more aloof; specialist or academic work suits you.

also.quote: 带孤克性质的天梁只宜从事专业，或学术研究

rules.text: 融和的一面較重：人際關係較好，際遇也較好；宜從政、從商，以計劃、監察、管理為宜，又有組織力，往往成為一行一業的領袖。
rules.en: The harmonious side is stronger: better relationships and better fortune; politics or business suit you, especially planning, oversight and management, and with your organising ability you often lead your field.

source.quote: 融和的天梁则人际关系较佳

also.quote: 所以又往往为一行一业的领袖

rules.text: 你的天梁在午帶孤剋，盤上又有融和的力量：多是半偏行業或紀律機構的領導人。
rules.en: Your Tian Liang in Wu carries a solitary edge, yet your chart also holds a harmonising force: such people often lead in semi-unconventional fields or disciplined organisations.

source.quote: 则多为半偏行业，或纪律要构的领导人

rules.text: 你的天梁在子化科，祿存在對宮拱照，又有輔佐吉星：這是融和之力最強的組合。
rules.en: Your Tian Liang in Zi is transformed by Ke, with Lu Cun shining from opposite and supporting stars in view: the most harmonious combination of all.
rules.edit: 原書另列三台八座等雜曜，引擎冇，條件不含。

source.quote: 最好的星曜组合是一一天梁在子化科

rules.text: 天同所在的那一步運，是你最喜歡的運，可能就是一生最好的大運。
rules.en: The phase that runs through Tian Tong suits you best of all; it may well be the finest decade of your life.

rules.text: 融和的你，行到天機太陰所在的運，是得意的時候。
rules.en: Being the harmonious kind, the phase through Tian Ji–Tai Yin is a time of success for you.

rules.text: 你孤獨與融和兩面都有：這樣的人，多在比較偏門的專業，或在講紀律的機構做領導。
rules.en: You carry both the solitary and the harmonious sides: people like this often lead in a specialist niche, or in a disciplined organisation.
